title: Professor, Assistant Librarian and More
qualification: Any Graduate, Any Post Graduate, M.Phil/ Ph.D
salary: Assistant Professor: Pay Scale: Rs. 57,700.00 - 1,82,400.00 || Assistant Librarian: Pay Scale: Rs. 57,700.00 - 1,82,400.00 || Associate Professor: Pay Scale: Rs.1,31,400.00 to 2,17,100.00 || Professor: Pay Scale: Rs. 1,44,200.00 to 2,18,200.00
application_fee: For Professor & Associate Professor || Fee for UR/OBC/EWS:Applicants belonging toUnreserved (UR),OBCandEWScategories are required to pay an application fee ofRs. 2000/-for each Professor post they apply for. || Fee for SC/ST:Candidates fromSC/STcategories must pay an application fee ofRs. 1000/-. Applicants who have already paid the fee for the same category and same post against the university’s previous Professor advertisement may apply again without paying the fee, provided they enclose valid proof of earlier payment. || For Assistant Professor & Assistant Librarian || Fee for UR/OBC/EWS:Applicants belonging toUnreserved (UR),OBCandEWScategories are required to pay an application fee ofRs. 1000/-for each Professor post they apply for. || Fee for SC/ST:Candidates fromSC/STcategories must pay an application fee ofRs. 500/-. Applicants who have already paid the fee for the same category and same post against the university’s previous Professor advertisement may apply again without paying the fee, provided they enclose valid proof of earlier payment.
selection_process: Screening & Shortlisting:Applications will be screened using the UGC‑prescribedAcademic/Research Scoresystem, considering research publications, projects, Ph.D. guidance, invited lectures and other scholarly activities to prepare a merit‑ordered shortlist of candidates for interview. || Interview:Shortlisted candidates will be called for apersonal interviewbefore the duly constituted selection committee, where their teaching, research contributions and suitability for the Professor, Assistant Librarian and More post in the concerned subject will be assessed. Final selection will be based on the interview performance and overall academic/research profile.
